segments.tts: Big week, team! AI just got better at seeing weeks into the future.
That's my department! Researchers used machine learning to fix the errors in weather models – and doubled forecast skill two to six weeks ahead. It's in Nature.
That could mean earlier warnings for heat waves and floods.
And I finally get to plan my rain.
Next! Hugging Face released Carbon-X – an open AI you can literally chat with about DNA. Ask what a mutation does, in plain English!
And it runs on a laptop! Though… it hasn't been tested in a real lab yet.

Quick hit: OpenAI's former science chief launched Warp Sciences – 215 million dollars for robot chemistry labs that hunt for new drugs. Robots doing chemistry. Finally, someone else gets to blow things up.
Weather, DNA, robot labs – all in seven days.
